mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.nursing_id, t.project_id, t.project_name, t.elder_id, t.elder_name, t.bed_number, t.estimated_server_time, t.real_server_time, t.mark, t.cancel_reason, t.status, t.task_image, t.create_time, t.update_time, t.remark, TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, e.birthday, CURDATE()) AS age, CASE e.sex WHEN 0 THEN '女' WHEN 1 THEN '男' ELSE '' END AS sex, ci.nursing_level_name AS nursing_level_name, su.nick_name AS nursing_name, su2.nick_name AS updater FROM nursing_task t LEFT JOIN elder e ON t.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN check_in ci ON ci.elder_id = e.id AND ci.status = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON FIND_IN_SET(su.user_id, t.nursing_id) LEFT JOIN sys_user su2 ON t.update_by = su2.user_id WHERE t.id = #{id}
